methods.name: PEVersion
methods.description: Specify your version using a string, for example: "1.8.9".

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description:
Compare to another PEVersion.
 If we are newer than the compared version,
 this method will return 1.
 If we are older than the compared version,
 this method will return -1.
 If we are equal to the compared version,
 this method will return 0.
 Similar toInteger.compareTo(Integer).

methods.name: isNewerThan
methods.description: Does thecompareTo(PEVersion)return 1?

methods.name: isOlderThan
methods.description: Does thecompareTo(PEVersion)return -1?
